name: io.github.alpro1000/oneiroscope
title: OneiroScope
description: Deterministic astrology and structural dream coding. Swiss Ephemeris natal charts with houses and applying/separating aspects, astrocartography line sets, relocation comparison, solar returns, lunar calendar, and Hall/Van de Castle dream coding where every count cites the clause it came from. Interpretation is a separate, labelled layer: each item carries its source and a confidence — computed 1.0, cited rule 0.9, symbol dictionary 0.8, model synthesis 0.7. Seven tools also ship an interactive view (MCP Apps) whose every row can hand its exact figures back to the conversation. Reflective / entertainment material, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.
